title: GroupMembershipCredential credential subject
description: The credential subject of an MDS GroupMembershipCredential, as validated by a verifier that resolves the credentialSchema of the presented credential. Backs the Group policy operand of profile version 2026/1.

id.description: The holder's DID. MUST equal the DID that authenticates in the presentation exchange.

participantId.description: The participant identifier assigned at onboarding. Bound to the ParticipantId policy operand.

groups.description: The MDS groups the participant belongs to, as a signed snapshot taken at issuance time. Bound to the Group policy operand. Identifiers are maintained by MDS governance and are not fixed by this profile version.
